meta_description:
29 likes, 4 comments - the_temptationalley on February 8, 2026: "Toast so good that even my kitchen towel could not resist eating it 😅😂 I have seen people trying persimmons and making viral persimmon cake / pudding but I so wanted to try something different and honestly I am glad I did. This is such a flavourful recipe.
.
Spicy, sweet and creamy at the same time.
.
Ingredients- 2 sourdough bread 
- 1 avocado 
- 1/2 onion and 1 tomato small 
- 1/4 tsp chilli flakes 
- 1 tsp lemon juice 
- salt as per taste 
- 1 persimmon 
- 1 tbsp feta crumble
- 1/2 tsp hot honey or normal honey 
.
#breakfastrecipe #whatiateforbreakfast #breakfastinspo #avotoast #avocadotoast persimmons persimmon sandwichrecipes healthybreakfastideas highproteinbreakfast highfiberdiet highproteindiet highproteinbreakfast".
